scope: Read-only point-in-time /proc snapshots of owned benchmark GPU child processes during near-256K prefill; includes HIP/runtime helper threads, not a count of C reactive worker threads
method: On pop@192.168.5.161, obtain container_host_pid and container_start_ticks from the run result.json; read /proc/<pid>/status Threads and count /proc/<pid>/task entries. No process signal or setting change.
